quest.title: The Black Serpent Knights' Glory
quest.description: Dainsleif figures out the Abyss Order's plan from the twin's memories left within the Inteyvat flower. Now to see if you can stop them or not...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Primogem x60, Mora x24250, Guide to Prosperity x2, Guide to Diligence x2, Guide to Gold x2, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Check the situation at the chamber at the center of the ruins' summit

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I thought he would've been turned to ashes in an instant... Halfdan's soul is extraordinarily resilient.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Lector
dialogues.text: Meddling fool! Encumber us no more...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Don't you have a greater encumbrance to worry about? Come on, this is your grand opportunity to get rid of me.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Lector
dialogues.text: ...Dainsleif!!!

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Take him out, and deactivate the device!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do now? The Abyss Lector's gone, but the device won't stop...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Halfdan...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: No! As long as the device is active, the cursed are rendered powerless. Only you can take on the Abyss.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: If you value his sacrifice, then do not waste any more time here.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: See all these rays of light and portals? They must have installed several of these energy devices in various locations. Find them! Quickly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So we have to... go through these Abyss portals? ...Hey, wait for Paimon!

choices.text: The cleansing won't have any effect on me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's it, right? The device is fully shut down now?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: The burning sensation has indeed stopped...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we managed to stop the Abyss Order's plan?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of all the ways to be reunited with one of his former comrades after so long... This is rough...

choices.text: He seems to have breathed his last.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was Halfdan's soul...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: More than one kind of strange power exists here. Souls are no strange sight under the circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Still, if you intend to venture deeper in and continue your investigation, you ought to be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: *cough*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You bet, we'll be super careful. Oh, but... Dain, does this mean you're not coming with us?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: That device took a severe toll on me. It will take me some time to recover.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right... Well, actually, Paimon already knew that. You've clearly been pushing through the pain this whole time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've earned a good rest, Dain... Ooh, you should take a vacation!

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: "Vacation"? Huh, the very notion. This word has no business being in my vocabulary.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: There are more important things that demand my attention. The "Loom of Fate" operation is still underway.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: And I suspect that these amplification devices are connected to that plan.

choices.text: I will be on the lookout.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I only hope that next time we meet, you know whose side you're on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sheesh! He sure knows how to hold a grudge, saving that snide remark right till the end...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, shame that we didn't get to see your {F#brother}{M#sister} again, but at least we learned some useful info, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As long as you keep pressing on with your journey, you guys will definitely meet again, and everything will be back to normal, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon almost forgot — the real reason we came here was to investigate what was going on with the hilichurls, wasn't it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've probably seen enough to report back to the miner now. But, uh... how are we going to explain it to him? This is all way too complicated for regular people to understand!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Meh, we'll figure it out — just don't forget about the commission when we're done here.

choices.text: We will talk more next time. After you've recovered.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The hilichurls are really suffering... Wait! Dain, this must be unbearable for you, too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Never mind that. Halfdan and the others are enduring far greater suffering than I. There's no time to lose!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, it's gone dark all around now. Shall we head back to the room in the center?
